com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Set or clear a client's default currency or posting account. Posting accounts must come from this workspace's saved accounting chart. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview setting the selected client's default currency to USD and posting account to the QuickBooks Online account we chose from the cached chart. Show the current defaults and wait for my confirmation.
Preview clearing only this client's currency default. Keep its posting-account default as it is and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_update_client_defaults, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare setting or clearing a client's currency and posting-account default. Posting accounts must belong to this workspace's current chart. Requires confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
